paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -7.36% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (-5.10%) and Nasdaq weakest (-10.02%). Brent crude changed -3.41% to 92.57. Gold changed -9.54% to 3,515.3999. Bitcoin changed -7.00% to 60,318.6602. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.912%, a relative move of -4.70%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-22.37%) and Newmont (-16.32%) moved the most.
